record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare AROMATHERAPY: Petilil (1 star) and Lilligant (2 stars); both have maxPP 100, range 1 and no declared passive. The strategy is shared; the only unit difference is the star count (table index).

dispatch.note: The strategy does not override requiresTarget or canCritByDefault, so the base defaults (target required, no crit unless the caster has ability crit) apply. The target passed to process is not used.

record.summary: After spending PP, every allied unit standing in one of the 8 cells adjacent to the caster has its negative-status cooldowns cleared (clearNegativeStatus zeroes the cooldowns; it does NOT clear the wound flag, which is reset later by updateWound in the status update) and is then, in the same synchronous call, healed by raw 20/40/80/160 (by caster stars; AP-scaled, crit only with ability crit). Because the flag is still true when handleHeal runs, a wounded adjacent ally still takes the wound branch: no HP (with BLOODMOON weather and a Blood Stone owned by that ally's player the branch first requests addShield(round(0.3 x stones x the raw requested heal), ally, apBoost 1, crit), with the ally as the shield's caster); the wound only ends at its next status update, so a later cast (or heal) can find it cleared. An unwounded ally with status.protect gets nothing (Rune Protect alone does not block); otherwise the heal goes through the usual modifiers, rounding and cap, and a GRASS-synergy ally's overheal requests addMaxHP(0.4 x overheal). The caster itself is not in the area (the adjacent-cell list excludes the centre) and nothing moves.

targeting.who: allies (same team) in the 8 cells adjacent to the caster's current cell; the caster is excluded
targeting.note: Unlike AQUA_RING there is no relocation: the area is centred on the caster where it stands. The enemy target that satisfied the cast gate is not used by the effect. Empty cells and enemies in the area are skipped.

geometry.shape: ring of up to 8 cells around the caster (3x3 block without the centre), clipped to the board

effects.resolution: Status.clearNegativeStatus zeroes the cooldowns of the listed negative statuses and resets curse and possession bookkeeping; it does not clear the boolean flags such as wound (probe: after clearing, wound is still true with woundCooldown 0). The flag is reset only when updateWound runs in the status update (woundCooldown - dt <= 0 -> wound = false). The heal that follows in the same synchronous callback therefore still sees status.wound = true.

effects.scaling: requested = table value. applied by PokemonState.handleHeal: x(1 + AP/100) with apBoost 1; x critPower if the cast crit; x1.3 with BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED; x0.5 when burning; x0.5 when enraged; x1.2 under ZENITH weather; rounded; capped to the target's missing HP (the remainder is overheal; on a GRASS-synergy ally it requests addMaxHP(0.4 x overheal), which also raises current HP). No HP heal on a wounded target (the flag is still set after the cleanse, see effects[0]), on an unwounded target with status.protect, or on a dead one; status.runeProtect is not read.
effects.resolution: requested (raw table) -> applied (after modifiers and rounding) -> healReceived (after the missing-HP cap). Each adjacent ally is healed once; full-HP allies receive 0 (the whole amount is overheal). A wounded ally receives 0 HP in this cast because clearNegativeStatus does not clear the flag before handleHeal; with BLOODMOON weather and a Blood Stone owned by that ally's player the wound branch requests addShield(round(0.3 x stones x raw heal), ally, 1, crit) (the ally is the shield's caster, so its own AP / crit power scale the request; Big Eater Belt x1.25 rounded down is applied by the entity addShield, final shield can differ from the request); the wound branch comes before the Protect test, so Protect does not stop it. The Grass overheal request addMaxHP(0.4 x overheal) is likewise a request: the final max HP and HP gain depend on addMaxHP's item helpers.

statusEffects.effect: negative statuses cleared (cooldowns zeroed) on each adjacent ally

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; 80 and 160 are not reached at the bare factory star counts of these units. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: Only allies in the cells adjacent to the caster at cast time receive anything; a caster with no adjacent ally heals and cleanses nobody (PP is still spent). The caster does not heal itself.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes; each cast reads the current neighbours.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: heal 20/40 (1/2 stars). Requested = raw; applied = raw x (1 + AP/100) x crit factor x the status/weather modifiers listed, rounded; healReceived is capped by missing HP. Cleansing happens before the heal for each ally, but clearNegativeStatus only zeroes the cooldown: a wounded ally still reads status.wound = true when the synchronous handleHeal runs, so it receives 0 HP (or only the Blood Moon / Blood Stone shield request) from this cast; the flag is cleared by updateWound at the next status update.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution - only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate was located
Which statuses count as negative beyond the list in clearNegativeStatus (only that function was read)
unresolved: Settled by source reading and the probe: clearNegativeStatus zeroes woundCooldown only, the heal is the next statement, so the wound flag is still true and a wounded adjacent ally gets 0 HP from this cast. Not traced: the exact order of the status update relative to other combat steps within a tick, i.e. when the flag clears afterwards
Whether the cast gate needs an enemy in range for these range-1 units: requiresTarget keeps the base default (true), but the moving-state walk-to-target logic was not re-read for this record
Whether the two units ever reach a different star count than the factory value
No routing uncertainties were queued for this record
No gameplay evidence; candidate is source reading plus mechanical checks only

Probe SHARED_HELPERS (real clearNegativeStatus / updateWound / handleHeal text, stub units): wound cooldown 3000 cleared -> wound true, cooldown 0; immediate heal 20 -> 0 / 0, HP unchanged; after updateWound(50) -> wound false and the next heal 20 -> 20. Also Protect -> 0 healed, Rune Protect alone -> healed, Grass 990/1000 heal 50 -> healed 10, overheal 40, addMaxHP request 16, wound + Protect + Blood Moon + one stone heal 20 -> addShield request 6. Helper requests and results only, not a fight.
